name: compressive strength
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 材料承受压缩作用的强度指标。
usage_overview: 在秸秆灰混凝土的材料性能评价中，通过立方体受压试验测定，用于比较不同替代率下混凝土的抗压承载表现。

complete_examples.text: Regarding compressive strength, the experimental data was more stable under a concrete strength standard of C20.
For example, under a strength standard of C40, the compressive strength is dropped by 25%, 43%, and 49% at dosages of 5%, 10%, and 15%, respectively.
The result shows that the structural resistance in the elastic and CAA stage increase as the compressive strength of infill wall increase.
Therefore, the effect of variation in the compressive strength of infill wall on the infilled-frame with various novel detailing is shown in Fig. 7.
